what_happened: The job to give OLY-9-11 a role-need mechanism shown in athena status was rejected at the final verdict. The verifier gave one blocker and no other findings. The retire rule in RoleNeed::compute (crates/athena-core/src/role_need.rs) always flags the steward, audience and auditor roles for retirement, though they are in active use. It builds its evidence from the job invocation scan (j.invocations), and that scan never sees those roles' runs. No acceptance criteria and no failed checks are listed.
cause: The retire rule was written against one data source, the per-job invocation list. Nothing required it to be run on the real records, or compared with known facts such as the steward, audience and auditor being active, before the job was judged. Those roles run outside job invocations, so the measure was blind to them by construction. The fixtures and tests the producer wrote fit the same assumption, so they passed. Only the verifier's independent check at the end exposed the gap.
other_causes: The criteria likely checked that the mechanism exists and shows in status, not that its retire verdicts are right for roles that are known to be active.
The producer was not told where each role's runs are recorded (job invocations versus steward, audience and auditor records).
open_hypotheses: Whether steward, audience and auditor runs are recorded anywhere the rule could read, or not recorded at all.
Whether the tests used fixtures with only job-run roles, which would explain why they passed. The fields do not show the tests.
prevention: Any job that adds a usage, need or retire measure must replay it over the real records before it is judged. The replay must be checked against a list of roles known to be active. A role whose runs are not in the measured source must be shown as "not measured", never as "unused" or "retire". The acceptance criteria should require the replay output to show the steward, audience and auditor as not flagged. The gate counts show no disagreements for any gate, so no gate is a candidate for relaxing or removing.
proposed_request: Give OLY-9-11 a role-need mechanism shown in athena status. Outcome: for every role in ALL_ROLES, status shows how much the role is needed, based on where that role's runs are really recorded. This includes the roles that run outside job invocations: steward, audience and auditor. First find where each role's runs are recorded. A role whose runs are not in any record the rule reads must be shown as "not measured", never as "retire". Acceptance: (1) a test runs RoleNeed::compute over a snapshot of real past records and shows steward, audience and auditor are not flagged for retirement. (2) A test shows a role that is truly unused is still flagged for retirement. (3) A test shows a role with no recorded source is shown as "not measured". (4) athena status prints the result for every role. (5) cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings and cargo test pass, with the budget figure in docs/system-facts.md updated if prompts change. (6) A CHANGELOG.md entry is added.
